title: fix(metadata-protocol): a plain clone does not report the source's empty readonly columns as dropped fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi935ZoSza1EBztq9TAUZYgTk)_

Fixes #29200

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：克隆记录时，源记录里为空的只读字段不再被复制进新记录的插入数据，所以一次什么都没改的克隆不会再在响应里报告"字段被丢弃"，`X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields` 响应头也不再出现。
- **为什么改**：控制台每次克隆一条只读字段为空的记录（如 showcase 联系人的 `lead_score`），都会提示"某些字段被丢弃"；集成方读 `droppedFields` 或响应头，会把每次克隆都当成丢了数据。用户其实什么都没发。
- **风险与回滚**：存下来的新记录与修复前逐字节相同（空值本来就会被剥掉、插入时空值与缺省同样取默认值）。只读字段有值时照旧复制、剥离并报告（#15703 裁决），`overrides` 里带只读字段也照旧报告。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `cloneData`（新增一行与注释）；`packages/rest/src/rest-dropped-fields-every-write-door.test.ts` 的 clone 用例（新增 3 个）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-dropped-fields-every-write-door.test.ts`，预期 18 个用例全过（需先构建 `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`cloneData` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) copied every column of the source row into the insert, read-only ones included, even where the source held `null`. `engine.insert`'s static-readonly strip judges every present key as caller-supplied, so it took that empty key and reported it. A plain clone (no `overrides`) of a row whose read-only column was empty therefore answered `droppedFields` naming that column, and since #29034 the `X-ObjectStack-Dropped-Fields` header repeated it.

The fix is on the producer side, as the contract review on #29034 ruled: in the loop that already removes engine-owned columns from the copy, a field declared `readonly` whose copied value is `null`/`undefined` is now left out of the insert payload. Nothing changes in `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`; the header still mirrors the body.

| clone | body `droppedFields` before → after | header before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| no overrides, source's read-only column empty | names the column → absent | names the column → absent |
| no overrides, source's read-only column holds a value | names the column → names the column | `ro;reason=readonly` → same |
| `overrides` sets the read-only field | names the column → names the column | `ro;reason=readonly` → same |

**Why the stored row is unchanged.** For a non-system caller the strip removed the empty key anyway. For every caller, the insert's `applyFieldDefaults` treats an explicit `null` exactly as an omitted key (`out[f.name] != null` is its only skip), so the copy takes the same default either way. Injected platform columns (`organization_id`, owner, audit) are `system: true` and were already removed from the copy by the existing branch.

**Acceptance 3 (a read-only column that holds a value) — measured, kept.** On `main` at `45e9b2f1`, a plain clone of a row whose `ro` holds `'seeded'` answers 201 with `droppedFields: [{ object, fields: ['ro'], reason: 'readonly' }]` and header `ro;reason=readonly`; after the fix it answers the same (the new control case passes on both trees). This is not the same defect: the value was really copied from the source and really stripped, so the caller reads the default back, and the maintainer ruling on #15703 (option 1, record 5578819560) is exactly that the clone reports this strip so the caller is told why. The card's route (a) is therefore applied to EMPTY read-only values only; dropping valued read-only columns from the copy would silence a report that ruling requires.

Route (b) (the engine strip not reporting a present `null` key) was not taken: it changes the #3431 "fields stripped from THIS write" report on every insert path, and a caller that really sends `ro: null` on a create did send that key.

## Why

The console announces every non-empty `droppedFields`, so users saw a "fields dropped" notice on a clone where they changed nothing, and integrations reading the body or the header would treat every such clone as data loss.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/rest-dropped-fields-every-write-door.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` + protocol + `RestServer` over better-sqlite3), three new clone cases on a new seed row `src_empty` (read-only `ro` left empty):
  - a plain clone of `src_empty`: 201, no `droppedFields`, no header, `record.ro` null (red on `main`);
  - `overrides: { ro: 'forged' }` on `src_empty`: still reported, body and header (control, acceptance 2);
  - a plain clone of `src1` (`ro: 'seeded'`): still reported, body and header (control, acceptance 3, #15703).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-static-readonly.dogfood.test.ts`: new case, a plain clone of a stock showcase contact whose `lead_score` is empty answers no `droppedFields` and no header.

**Forced test edits** (assertions that accommodated the defect):

- dogfood `clone with overrides.lead_score`: the header assertion moves from `toContain('lead_score;reason=readonly')` to `toBe('lead_score;reason=readonly')`, and its comment ("a plain clone copies the source's other readonly columns too, so the header may name more than lead_score") is rewritten, since the copy no longer carries empty read-only columns.
- rest test file: the comment above `CLONE_OBJECT` ("a clone of a PROJ row also reports the source's `ro2`") is rewritten to say only valued read-only columns are copied; no assertion moved. The seed gains one row (`src_empty`); no case counts that object's rows.

## Acceptance notes

- Serial note: open PR #28731 edits `protocol.ts` at `probeRecord`; this diff touches only `cloneData`.
- The showcase cannot exercise acceptance 3 (its only read-only column, `lead_score`, cannot be given a value by a non-system caller); the real-stack rest test carries it.
